title: Umuhamagaro Utarumviwe mu Gihugu c'Ubwibone .
intro: Uhagaze mu bihomvagurike vy’iterambere ryari rikomeye cane, aho ububasha n’ubwibone bitagira aho bigarukira. Intumwa yagendagenda hagati yabo, ihamagara ukuri, ariko imitima yabo irakomantaye. Iyo ngabisho ntiyakurikijwe, kandi ijuru ubwaryo ricitse igikoresho c’ishavu. None iyo ntumwa yari nde, kandi abo banse iyo nkuru babayeho gute?
clues: Narungitswe ku bantu batagira uko bangana mu nkomezi, kandi bubatse ku kibanza cose co hejuru ikimenyetso.
Abantu banje baribona ko ataco bashobora gutsindwa, bavuga bati: «Ni nde aturusha ububasha mu nkomezi?»
Nabahamagariye gusenga Allah wenyene, ariko banshinja ko ndi ubupfu n’ikinyoma.
Baca bantera intege ngo nzane igihano nasezeranye nimba ndi umunyakuri.
Allah yabarungikiye umuyaga w’ingumba utagira ico uzigama ku kintu na kimwe wajeko.
Jewe n’abemeranye nanje twakijijwe n’imbabazi za Allah, abahakanyi na bo baratikijwe burundu.

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Hudi n’abizera bararokotse, abahakanyi na bo baratikizwa .
Hud yaduzwe mu kibanza co hejuru .
Hudi yarahevye abantu biwe imbere y'igihano ico ari co cose .
outcome.answer: Hudi n’abizera bararokotse, abahakanyi na bo baratikizwa .

arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ۖ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verse: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers. (7:72)
